messages.subject: Review done: 7 findings, 3 High — claim falsified for paired clients
messages.body: Reviewed the auto-reconnect-budget branch (all 10 modified + 2 untracked files), traced every ssh.connect caller across desktop/web/RPC, and ran the touched suites (181+538 tests) plus full typecheck — all green. Core desktop mechanism is sound, but I found 7 issues: High — (F1) the runtime RPC drops the initiator field so paired web/mobile clients default to 'user', resetting the budget and re-launching 5x30s connect storms on every pane remount, which falsifies the branch claim; (F2) the wall-clock budget counts system-sleep time and the resume handler hard-skips exhausted targets, regressing #7773 wake recovery; (F3) 60s budget vs 30s connect timeout gives a black-holing host ~2 attempts and the never-expiring pause means any >60s blip permanently breaks unattended automation dispatch until a human clicks Connect. Remaining: Medium F4 (stale exhausted window survives clean disconnect → false 'host unreachable' hours later) and F5 (budget enforced only at the IPC gate; connect()/reconnect() and never-connected hosts bypass it), plus two Lows — full evidence with file:line in the report.
